readerCopy.body: Something you already know how to do can make today easier without deciding what comes next. The Sun sextile the South Node can bring an old skill, contact, audience, or role back into useful reach. You may know exactly how to handle the meeting, make the introduction, or step into a responsibility because you have done it before. Use that competence where it helps. The opening becomes less useful if being good at the old role is the reason you keep choosing it.
